faq.a: Use at least 3 chapters, start the first one at 0:00, keep every chapter at least 10 seconds long, and put each timestamp on its own line in the description. This tool checks each rule as you type.

faq.q: Does this add chapters to my video automatically?
faq.a: No. Copy the generated block into your video description. YouTube creates the chapter markers when the description meets its rules.

faq.q: Which time format should I use?
faq.a: Enter m:ss for short videos or h:mm:ss for long videos. The tool normalises the format and always outputs the shortest valid timestamp.
